    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    ActivityEntry
    A single entry in the recent-activity feed.
    ActivityEntry.Kind
    Visual categories of activity, each mapped to an icon on the UI.
    ActivityLog
    In-memory log of recent inventory events for the current session.
    AddItemPanel
    Dedicated "Add New Item" page.
    AnalyticsPanel
    Analytics screen: deeper look at inventory composition.
    AppConfig
    Application-wide preferences persisted to stockly.properties.
    DashboardPanel
    Landing screen showing live inventory statistics.
    Dialogs
    Styled modal dialogs matching the STOCKLY visual identity.
    DonutChart
    Donut chart showing how many products fall into each stock status.
    Icon
    Lightweight vector icon set drawn with Graphics2D.
    InventoryManager
    Central data-access object for the inventory.
    InventoryManager.InventoryException
    Raised when validation fails or an id cannot be resolved.
    InventoryManager.InventoryListener
    Callback invoked after every successful mutation.
    InventoryPanel
    Inventory screen: searchable, filterable, sortable product table.
    InventoryPanel.ProductActions
    Callback interface so the frame can open product dialogs.
    Main
    STOCKLY — Premium Inventory Management System.
    MainFrame
    Application shell: sidebar + top bar + card-switched content pages.
    Product
    Represents a single inventory product.
    ProductDetailsDialog
    Read-only product details dialog.
    ProductDialog
    Modal dialog for adding a new product or editing an existing one.
    PromptField
    Text field that shows a grey hint when empty.
    QuantityBarChart
    Horizontal bar chart showing each product's stock quantity.
    ReportShots
    Captures genuine screenshots of EVERY STOCKLY screen and state for the OEL report.
    Screenshot
    Captures real screenshots of every application page using Robot screen capture.
    ScrollBarKit
    Scroll-pane factory producing STOCKLY-styled thin scrollbars.
    SelfTest
    Headless self-test for the inventory engine.
    SettingsPanel
    Settings screen organised into clear sections.
    Sidebar
    Fixed left navigation sidebar for the application.
    StockStatus
    Stock status classification for a product.
    TableKit
    Shared table-chrome helpers for STOCKLY.
    TableKit.ActionCellRenderer
    Cell renderer producing the three centred row-action buttons.
    TableKit.ProductStatusShim
    Tiny carrier so the status column can pass the enum through the model.
    TableKit.RowIconButton
    Square icon button (view / edit / delete) drawn with the vector Icon set.
    TableKit.SearchBox
    Rounded search field: magnifier icon painted inside the left padding, borderless text field filling the rest, optional placeholder text when empty.
    TableKit.StatusCellRenderer
    Table-cell renderer that returns a TableKit.StatusPill sized to fit its text, centred in the cell.
    TableKit.StatusPill
    A fully rounded status badge.
    TableKit.StyledComboUI
    Combo-box UI with a custom-drawn triangular arrow and flat ivory styling that matches the rounded search field.
    Theme
    Central design tokens for the Stockly interface.
    TopBar
    Top navigation bar shown above every page.
    UIComponents
    Reusable styled Swing components shared across the application.
    UIComponents.Caption
    Muted helper text label.
    UIComponents.Card
    Rounded surface panel used as the base for cards and sections.
    UIComponents.GhostButton
    Quiet secondary button with a soft grey fill.
    UIComponents.PrimaryButton
    Forest-green primary action button with a subtle hover state.
    UIComponents.SectionTitle
    Section heading with optional muted subtitle.
    UIComponents.StatusBadge
    Pill-shaped status badge showing the stock status.
    UITest
    Headed (but invisible) UI verification for STOCKLY.
